lines.text: OpenAI makes its Decisions API generally available, a fast GPT-6 Luna tool for the small choices agents make
Reuters: Anthropic still aims for a mid-November IPO, with its prospectus public as early as late October
Supermicro launches a liquid-cooled rack of 256 Nvidia Vera CPUs to run AI agents in data centers

feed.headline: OpenAI makes its Decisions API generally available, built on GPT-6 Luna for quick yes/no-style choices
feed.why: Apps and agents make many small routing and sorting calls; OpenAI says this does them up to 10x faster than Luna through its main API.

feed.headline: Reuters: Anthropic is pressing ahead with a mid-November IPO; prospectus public as early as late October
feed.why: Reuters widens Yahoo's 'as soon as Friday' S-1 report. Anthropic declined to comment, and the dates may change.

feed.headline: Supermicro offers a liquid-cooled rack of 256 Nvidia Vera CPUs for running AI agents in data centers
feed.why: Agents need lots of ordinary processors next to the GPUs; Supermicro says one rack holds up to 22,500 agent sandboxes. Available to quote now.

feed.headline: Mistral and Nvidia team up on AI for engineering design, with public benchmarks and open datasets
feed.why: Shared tests for AI agents doing simulation and chip-design work would let buyers compare them. Mistral restates Large 4 weights for end of October.

feed.headline: Infineon expands work with Nvidia on gallium nitride power parts for 800-volt AI data centers
feed.why: Feeding power to dense AI racks is a growing limit; higher voltage and GaN chips aim to cut losses and save space.

feed.headline: LiteLLM traces its malware release to GitHub tokens that leaked into its own logs via Claude Code
feed.why: LiteLLM says Claude Code can put GitHub login tokens into responses that then get logged. Anyone logging AI responses should check for leaked secrets.

feed.headline: BBC: Google DeepMind staff are quitting over Google's AI deals with the US military
feed.why: Two named researchers say Google can't see or control how the Pentagon uses its AI. Google says it reviews such contracts under its AI principles.

feed.headline: Anthropic is expected to start pitching its IPO to investors the week of 9 November
feed.why: Per Reuters' sources. Under SEC rules the S-1 must be public 15 days before that pitch starts, so it should land by late October.
